checks.name: PR46-I01 / AC-F04-22 / TEST-F04-I10: ANONYMOUS duplicate POST rejects mode before duplicate without writes
checks.expected: ANONYMOUS Published duplicate and first submission both 409 MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED, before duplicate handling; original response rows unchanged.
checks.actual: Both 409 MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED, exact error-only envelope, no sentinel, unchanged participation/bundle/answer snapshot. IDENTIFIED duplicate control returned RESPONSE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED.

checks.name: PR46-I02 / AC-F05-01 / TEST-F05-I02: own Draft results reject state before mode without statistics or mutation
checks.expected: Own Draft results 409 RESULTS_NOT_AVAILABLE in either mode; no data or mutation. Foreign Owner 404; Respondent 403.
checks.actual: Exact expected 409/error-only response for IDENTIFIED and ANONYMOUS Draft; unchanged Draft, empty response rows, correct 404/403 controls.
actualAssertionSource: expect((await pool.query('SELECT to_jsonb(s) AS row FROM "Survey" s WHERE id=$1', [d.id])).rows[0].row).toEqual(before);

checks.name: PR46-I03 / AC-F05-21 / TEST-F05-I02: own ANONYMOUS Published and Closed results reject without count or text fallback
checks.expected: Own ANONYMOUS Published/Closed results 409 MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED, no result payload and unchanged responses; normal identified results still work.
checks.actual: Both states returned exact 409 MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED with no count/text, unchanged rows. IDENTIFIED count-only and Closed comment controls returned 200.

checks.name: PR46-I04-PUBLISHED / AC-F04-22 / TEST-F04-I10: ANONYMOUS own readback rejects without identified-answer fallback
checks.expected: 409 MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED, top-level error only, no synthetic answer sentinel, unchanged persisted rows.
checks.actual: 200, no error.code, top-level data, synthetic answer sentinel present; persisted rows unchanged.

checks.name: PR46-I04-CLOSED / AC-F04-22 / TEST-F04-I10: ANONYMOUS own readback rejects without identified-answer fallback
checks.expected: 409 MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED, top-level error only, no synthetic answer sentinel, unchanged persisted rows.
checks.actual: 200, no error.code, top-level data, synthetic answer sentinel present; persisted rows unchanged.

observedDefect.condition: Eligible respondent with an existing identified response; a test-only ANONYMOUS survey fixture in PUBLISHED or CLOSED state.
observedDefect.actual: 200 with data, submitted status and the existing identified answers; the synthetic answer sentinel is present.
observedDefect.cause: Readback applies role/eligibility/state scoping but has no mode guard before reading participation/bundle/answers. POST responses and GET results already reject unsupported mode.
observedDefect.impact: Violation of AC-F04-22 / TEST-F04-I10 fail-closed readback. Conditional on unsupported mode existing in storage; production enum currently rejects ANONYMOUS, so no ordinary API path enabling anonymous collection or cross-user access was demonstrated.
observedDefect.disposition: Team decision: PR46-DEF-01 is a Known Limitation discovered during additional post-release verification. PR46-I04-PUBLISHED and PR46-I04-CLOSED are two observations of the same underlying unsupported-mode own-readback defect. AC-F04-22 remains a Sprint 1 AC with Partial disposition. Correction is deferred for team follow-up in Sprint 2 before enabling F-06 Anonymous Mode; regression tests must be rerun after correction. The defect is not fixed. The existing Sprint Plan and original assessed release are unchanged.
